extraction_warnings: This paper is a multi-omics case study of 20 individuals across 4 families; most participant-level demographic/clinical details (age, sex, subject/sample IDs, family roles) are stated to be in Supplementary Section 1 / Supplementary Table 1, which is not included in the provided text, so many required fields are 'not_reported'.
The schema appears designed for per-subject/sample rows, but the provided text only supports study-level aggregate extraction; granularity was set to 'study_level' accordingly.

The 'control' field could not be assigned a single study-level value because the cohort explicitly contains both T1DM cases and healthy relative controls; subgroup-level assignment would require the full per-individual list from Supplementary Table 1.
DNA extraction used two kits (Norgen Biotek All-In-One kit as primary, MOBIO Power Soil Kit as supplement); only the primary kit was recorded as the field value.
Batch 1 returned granularity='subgroup_level', differs from batch 0 ('study_level'); kept batch 0.
Batch 1 subgroups ['T1DM', 'Healthy'] differ from batch 0 []; kept batch 0.

Most demographic/clinical schema fields (age, BMI values, HLA typing, dietary restriction specifics, smoking, antibiotics use) are referenced only as existing in Supplementary Table 1/Section 1, which is not included in the provided paper text; they could not be extracted from the main text.

Schema fields related to oncology (tumor staging, RECIST, ORR, PFS), neonatal outcomes, obstetric/gynecologic status, and FMT are not applicable to this T1DM gut microbiome study and were marked not_reported.

Disease/treatment fields were assigned subgroup-level granularity based on the clear T1DM vs healthy family member stratification described throughout the paper (e.g., Fig. 1a legend, Results sections).

Schema fields (ecog_performance_status, disease_response_os, tumor_size_measurement, tumor_size_residual_measurement, feces_phenotype_value) appear designed for oncology/clinical trial studies and are largely inapplicable to this microbiome multi-omics paper.
